name: Octavia E. Butler Landing Site
summary: Touchdown site of NASA's Perseverance rover (Feb 18, 2021) on the flat crater floor.
science_goal: Baseline calibration and thermal/atmospheric station deployment.

name: South Séítah Sand Dunes & Ridges
summary: Region of deep wind-blown sand ripples and rugged olivine-bearing bedrock.
science_goal: Study igneous rock alteration by ancient groundwater.

name: Three Forks Sample Depot
summary: Flat, stable ground at the base of the western river delta where 10 sample tubes were cached.
science_goal: Primary staging area before ascending the steep delta front.

name: Jezero Western River Delta Front
summary: Steep layered sedimentary cliff formed 3.5 billion years ago where a river flowed into Lake Jezero.
science_goal: Search for concentrated organic molecules and microbial biosignatures in mudstones.

name: Neretva Vallis Ancient Inlet Channel
summary: Carved river valley through Jezero's western rim that fed water into the crater lake.
science_goal: Examine bright-toned carbonate rocks and crater rim transition.
